name: carry-home-to-child
text:
A child episode receives the `HOME` variable its parent holds.

The home directory is the one the passwd database records for the user; where
the database holds no entry, the runtime reads `HOME` instead
(`crates/transport/src/paths.rs`). A child episode is started with a cleared
environment (`crates/core/src/spawn.rs`), so on a host that keeps accounts in a
directory service the root episode resolves its home directory from `HOME`, and
every child it starts fails during construction with neither a database entry
nor a variable to read.

The parent passes `HOME` to each child it starts, with the value the parent
holds. Where the database holds an entry, that entry decides the home directory
in a child as in its parent. The cleared environment carries no other variable.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/models.md: a child episode starts with a cleared environment, so its parent carries home across to it; otherwise a child would find neither a database entry nor a fallback on a host where the root episode ran on one.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: the tests of foe-core, clippy with warnings denied on the same crates, and scripts/loc.sh.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
